entries.description: A 40-acre farm in Mississippi caretaken by an intentional family of four lesbians, two living on the land and two in cities sharing financial responsibility, with extended family helping with farmwork. Interests in spiritual development and organic farming; offers training in back-to-the-earth skills. Has housing, electricity, outhouse, kitchen water, camping, woods and farmland. Welcomes new members, girl and boy children, non-lesbian women and leashed dogs.
entries.raw_text: SILVER CIRCLE FARM c/o Gwen O Demeter, Rt 5 Box 100, Holly Springs, MS 38635. We are presently two wimmin living on the land and two wimmin living in different cities who share financial/emotional responsibilities for caretaking 40 acres. We are an intentional family of four who enjoy the support of several other extended family members who visit regularly to help with the farmwork and enjoy its special energy. Our interests include spiritual tolerance and development, organic farming, prosperity thinking and being, networking, and providing a working example of an alternative to patriarchal patterns. We give training in survival back to the earth skills: organic gardening, woodswomanship, natural healing, carpentry, plumbing, etc. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs on leash. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity, outhouse, running water in kitchen, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Land location: rural route address ("Rt 5 Box 100"), so the land. Type: although only "two wimmin living on the land", the group calls itself "an intentional family of four" sharing responsibility for the land, so Intentional Community/Cooperative rather than Private/Individual Land (judgment call). num_residents 2: "two wimmin living on the land"; the other two of the "4 lesbians" live "in different cities" and are not counted. Accepted: lesbians living there; "nonlesbian women" named; "girl & boy children". Focuses: Spirituality ("spiritual tolerance and development"); Farming ("organic farming", "help with the farmwork"); Workshops ("We give training in survival back to the earth skills"). Organic farming treated as part of farming, not coded Environmentalism.

entries.description: A 250-acre women's land trust in Kentucky, about 7 miles from Monticello, holding land in perpetuity for women to form community. Supportive members may use the land for camping and workshops; community members may live there and own their improvements. Aims to grow food organically and teach alternative skills. Has a house, barn, electricity, camping, woods and farmland; welcomes new members, girl children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: SPIRAL WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 337, Monticello, KY 42633 (606)348-5215 (7 mi from Monticello). Spiral is an all wimmin's space, open to membership. Supportive Membership is for wimmin to use the land for camping/workshops or just to be supportive. Community Membership entitles one to live here, be part of the community and own one's own improvements. In brief, our purposes say: To hold land in perpetuity, for wimmin to form community, to grow food organically, to provide education of alternative skills, etc. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 30 lesbians, 3 nonlesbians, 250 acres, 1 house, 1 barn, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: PO box, so no land street/zip; land_state KY from mailing state since land is "7 mi from Monticello" (no land town named). Type: named a land trust with purpose "To hold land in perpetuity". num_residents 33 from "30 lesbians, 3 nonlesbians" with "women living and working on the land"; uncertain, since Supportive Members may not live there. Accepted: lesbians; "nonlesbian women" named (and nonlesbians among members); "girl children" only. Focuses: Farming ("to grow food organically"); Workshops ("to provide education of alternative skills", "camping/workshops").

entries.land_location_as_stated: NW Michigan 1 hr from Traverse City - Jordan River Valley
entries.description: A 40-acre lesbian community in the Jordan River Valley of northwest Michigan, bought in May 1985, with two small houses, a barn and apple trees. Primarily spiritual, eclectic with a lesbian feminist emphasis; basically vegetarian with shared incomes. Plans gatherings, lesbian spiritual circles, a liaison with local Native women and a healing sanctuary. Six lesbians live there; welcomes new members from fall 1986, women of color, girl children and dogs.
entries.raw_text: O.W.L. SANCTUARY Rt 1 Box 209-A, E Jordan, MI 49727 (616)536-2903 (NW Michigan 1 hr from Traverse City - Jordan River Valley). In May '85 land, with two smallish houses, a barn, apple trees, critters and nature spirits, was purchased. We see our primary focus as a spiritual one, experiencing and developing our psychic, spiritual and nature-all inter-connectedness with a commitment to aid the healing of the Earth Mother. Our spirituality is eclectic in its background and manifestations, but has a decidedly Lesbian Feminist emphasis. The community space is considered basically vegetarian and incomes are shared. Future goals include sponsoring wimmin's gatherings and events, creating ongoing Lesbian spiritual circles, establishing a liaison with area Native wimmin and offering a healing, contemplative space to wimmin needing sanctuary. We welcome: new members/residents in Fall '86, wimmin of color, girl children, dogs. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Land location: rural route ("Rt 1 Box 209-A"), so the land. Type: six lesbians living together, "community space", "incomes are shared" → Intentional Community/Cooperative. num_residents 6 from "6 lesbians" with "women living on the land". Accepted: lesbians; "girl children" only; 1986, "wimmin" read as lesbians. Focuses: Spirituality ("our primary focus as a spiritual one", "Lesbian spiritual circles"); Women of color ("We welcome: ... wimmin of color", "liaison with area Native wimmin"). "aid the healing of the Earth Mother" not treated as an explicit environmental practice; vegetarian noted, not coded.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Atwood, on Lake Michigan in NW lower peninsula
entries.description: A 70-acre farm near Atwood on Lake Michigan in Michigan's northwest lower peninsula, where two lesbians live in a clean, sober, nicotine-free old stone cabin with a garden and trailer hookups. Plans a woodworking collective, berry and fruit farm, writer's hermitage and horses once paid off (Dec 1986). Welcomes new members, girl children, Native American women and other lesbians of color, and dogs.
entries.raw_text: MAPLE ROW FARM Rt 1 Box 88, Ellsworth, MI 49729 (616)599-2013 (Atwood, on Lake Michigan in NW lower peninsula). We live in a clean and sober, nicotine-free 80-year-old stone cabin with 2 cats. We have a car, truck and motorcycle, a 30' x 50' garden, a foundation for another building, and septic and electrical hookups available for a trailer. Many adjoining acreages for sale. Visions are for a woodworking collective, berry and fruit farm, writer's hermitage, and horses once the land is paid off (Dec '86). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, Native American Women, other dykes of color, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 70 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.

"writer's hermitage" vision not coded as cultural work. Adjoining acreage for sale not counted.

entries.community_name: WICONSIN WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP - D.O.E. FARM
entries.description: An 80-acre women's land cooperative in west central Wisconsin owning Daughters of Earth Farm: hilly, secluded land, half wooded campground with some chemical-free space and half hayfield, orchard and garden. Four year-round residents, more in summer, and 125 members, almost all lesbians; ten-year anniversary in 1987. Sliding scale fees; welcomes new members, girl children and non-lesbian women.

The land is hilly, secluded, and very beautiful; half wooded campground (some chemical free space), half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc, in west central Wisconsin. Four year-round residents, more in summer. Ten-year anniversary in '87. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian womyn. Sliding scale fees. We have/are: 6-15 lesbians in group, 125 members almost all lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
